i.norm: Tests that LoessInterpolator rejects x-values that are not strictly increasing. Loess smoothing requires x-values to be in strictly ascending order; if they are not, a NonMonotonicSequenceException should be thrown.
Verifies that smooth() throws NonMonotonicSequenceException when x-values are not strictly increasing (here: 4, 3, 1, 2 contains a decrease from 4→3).
